description: This file implements the PyInterpreter class and related functions for managing Python tensor interactions within the PyTorch C++ backend, including GPU tracing macros, dispatching, reference counting, and tensor attribute caching.

classes.name: ConcretePyInterpreterVTable
classes.description: Implements the virtual table for Python interpreter operations, including reference counting, tensor dispatch, and GPU event tracing.

classes.name: PyInterpreterHolder
classes.description: Manages the lifetime of the PyInterpreter instance, including registration and disarmament.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the Python interpreter instance.

methods.name: incref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a PyObject.

methods.name: decref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a PyObject.

methods.name: try_incref
methods.description: Attempts to increment the reference count of a PyObject slot.

methods.name: refcnt
methods.description: Returns the reference count of a PyObject.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches a TensorImpl into a Tensor object via Python dispatch.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is contiguous with specified memory format.

methods.name: sym_is_contiguous
methods.description: Symbolic version of is_contiguous, returning a symbolic boolean.

methods.name: is_strides_like
methods.description: Checks if tensor strides are like a specified format.

methods.name: is_non_overlapping_and_dense
methods.description: Checks if tensor is non-overlapping and dense.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the device of the tensor.

methods.name: dim
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions of the tensor.

methods.name: strides
methods.description: Returns the strides of the tensor.

methods.name: sizes
methods.description: Returns the sizes of the tensor.

methods.name: sym_sizes
methods.description: Returns the symbolic sizes of the tensor.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Returns the layout of the tensor.

methods.name: numel
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the tensor.

methods.name: sym_numel
methods.description: Returns the symbolic number of elements.

methods.name: sym_storage_offset
methods.description: Returns the symbolic storage offset.

methods.name: sym_strides
methods.description: Returns the symbolic strides.

methods.name: reset_backward_hooks
methods.description: Resets the backward hooks of a tensor.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the interpreter.
